An unknown key comes *first*, before any key the format interprets, so a writer that appends
unknown keys by walking the original order has to move it to the end rather than leaving it in
front of the relations. The relations are also out of schema order.

`relation:root` is undeclared as of the pre-stage-4 refactor, so this file carries two preserved
keys rather than one, and their relative order has to survive a write. `relation:reply_to` names a
note that does exist, so the derived root has somewhere to walk.
